Build stamp in the corner

2026-10-21 · PoSeeReview · the deploy's YYMMDD now sits bottom-right on every page.

  • What changed: a small dark pill, bottom-right, showing the HEAD commit's UTC date as YYMMDD (here 261008).
  • Where it comes from: the StampBuildDate MSBuild target runs git rev-list -1 --timestamp HEAD and stamps an assembly attribute. No git means today's UTC date.
  • Behaviour: never a tap target (pointer-events: none), sits under the toast, respects the safe-area insets, and is the same in both themes because it uses the always-dark inverse surface.

Server-rendered images, now drawn with SkiaSharp

ImageSharp was swapped for SkiaSharp to clear seven advisories (ImageSharp's fixes are 4.x-only, and 4.x needs a license key to build in Release). These are renders from the new code using a synthetic gradient as the artwork. Captions are now set in Bangers (embedded), and the card in DM Sans Bold (embedded). There is no "before" render: the old code no longer restores, because NuGet audit blocks it.
